items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Dickie Wells and Miriam Burton were not supposed to go to the Chikito with me... Mariam Burton came to Paris where she was living.

ctx.x: Zutty started to tell me almost every week, that he wanted to be paid for the two nights that we would not work at the Chikito. And every week, I would tell him that I was not being paid for the two nights either, and I was not going to pay him as a special favour from my pocket.

Dickie Wells and Miriam Burton were not supposed to go to the Chikito with me and our last concert was at Chaux-de-Fonds,Switzerland, the 13th of December. Dickie left for France the next day to go back to New York and Mariam Burton came to Paris where she was living.

We started in the Chikito on Tuesday the 16th, had the Christmas night off. We were paid every Monday night, and our first pay came on the 22nd. It was the 29th when we received our second week's salary, minus the Christmas night that we didn't work. Zutty had asked me to be paid in dollars and that's how I paid him. So this time, when I gave him his salary and he counted it, he told me that it was not the right amount. I told him it was right because we were not paid for the night we didn't work.
